verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented check-issuance API and no check deposit or remote-deposit image-capture capability. The only check reference is a paper check issued with the remaining balance when an account closes. That is a side effect of account closure, not programmatic check issuance, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper
